# Is your code verifying JWTs, or just reading them?

> Paste your JavaScript, Python, Go or Java code and find JWT verification misuse: jwt.decode where verify is needed, verify_signature False, alg none, unpinned algorithms, ignoreExpiration, hard-coded or weak secrets. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/jwt-verification-misuse-check/)
- [JWT verification misuse: decode vs verify, alg: none and how to fix each](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/jwt-verification-misuse-check/what-is-jwt-verification-misuse.html)
